head: Windows 11 RAM usage: Microsoft's own apps now use 860 MB less
dek: Microsoft said at Ignite 2026 that its own apps on Windows 11 now use over 860 MB less memory: Office 360 MB less, and Defender, Purview and OneDrive together over half a gigabyte less.
details: Windows also skips loading some parts it used to load, and parts built on the same frameworks now share memory. Microsoft says Office apps run about 10% faster on 8 GB PCs, and that some of the changes came with the October 2026 update. The work since January aimed at 8 GB and 16 GB PCs, partly because memory prices have gone up. In Windows Latest's own test, an 8 GB laptop used about 3.3 GB after a restart on 26H2, down from about 5 GB on 25H2.
where: Windows 11 PCs, part of it with the October 2026 update
means: If your PC has 8 or 16 GB of memory, more of it is left for your own apps and browser tabs once the updates are in.
todo: Install the latest Windows and Microsoft 365 updates in Settings, Windows Update, then restart the PC.
thumb_words: WINDOWS 11 APPS USE 860 MB LESS RAM
